name: gen-suite-bed
description: GEN-DOOR-OFFSET (v0.31.9.17): tpl-hdb-3gen's Grandparent Suite ships with a bed. Its door was centred on the 3.56 m north wall, so the 0.90 m swing keep-out split that wall into 1.28 m and 1.38 m runs — both 0.14 m short of a 1.52 m bed-queen in every orientation — and dropDoorBlockers deleted the bed, leaving two nightstands flanking nothing. Door moved to the west jamb: 2.68 m clear run, +8 pieces.

steps.name: assert-suite-has-a-bed
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>x.id==='g3-gen');const inRoom=s.items.filter(i=>i.position[0]>=r.origin[0]&&i.position[0]<=r.origin[0]+r.width&&i.position[1]>=r.origin[1]&&i.position[1]<=r.origin[1]+r.depth);const beds=inRoom.filter(i=>String(i.defId).startsWith('bed-'));if(beds.length===0)throw new Error('Grandparent Suite has no bed; contains: '+inRoom.map(i=>i.defId).sort().join(', '))})()
steps.failMessage: the Grandparent Suite must ship with a bed (v0.31.9.17)
